questions.question: Sami calls Mina: 'A patient with a Grade 3 furcation! What should we do?' Mina replies:

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is periodontal regeneration?' Mina replies:

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When is a gingival graft indicated?' Mina replies:
options: For Class I and II recessions in motivated patients
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Grafts are indicated for recessions with a good prognosis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a graft for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage aggressive periodontitis in a young patient?' Mina replies:
options: Intensive periodontal treatment + antibiotic therapy + close follow-up
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Aggressive periodontitis requires an aggressive approach.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat this patient intensively.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a periodontal flap?' Mina replies:
options: A surgical technique to access deep pockets
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The flap allows access and debridement of deep pockets.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer to a specialist.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use guided tissue regeneration?' Mina replies:
options: For vertical bone loss with good prognosis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'GTR is indicated for bone loss with a good prognosis.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose GTR for this patient.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a recurrent periodontal abscess?' Mina replies:
options: Treat the underlying cause (deep pocket, foreign body)
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Recurrent abscesses are often linked to a deep pocket.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat the causal pocket.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of periodontal relapse?' Mina replies:
options: Bleeding on probing, increased pockets, bone loss
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Relapse is multifactorial.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will monitor these signs.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with periodontitis and cardiovascular disease?' Mina replies:
options: Coordinate with the attending physician, treat the periodontitis
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Coordination with the physician is essential.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will contact their cardiologist.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a Miller Class IV recession?' Mina replies:
options: A recession with no coverage possible
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Miller IV has a very guarded prognosis, with no coverage possible.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will inform the patient of the prognosis.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a Miller Class II recession?' Mina replies:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Miller II has a good prognosis for total coverage.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose a graft.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the advantages of flap surgery compared to deep scaling?' Mina replies:
options: Direct access, visualization, debridement of deep pockets
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The flap offers direct access to deep pockets.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will refer for a flap.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage severe generalized periodontitis?' Mina replies:
options: Treatment by quadrant, re-evaluation, surgery if necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The strategy is gradual and adapted.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will treat by quadrant.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is post-extraction osteitis?' Mina replies:
options: An infectious inflammation of the bone after extraction
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Osteitis is a post-extraction complication.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will prevent this complication.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a patient with periodontitis and pregnancy?' Mina replies:
options: Basic periodontal treatment, avoid X-rays and medications
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Periodontal treatment is possible with precautions.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will adapt the treatment.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the risks of untreated periodontitis?' Mina replies:

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage vertical bone loss?' Mina replies:
options: Evaluate the possibility of regeneration or filling
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Vertical losses are often regenerable.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will propose regeneration.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is active periodontal maintenance?' Mina replies:
options: Close follow-up with scaling and regular re-evaluation
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Active maintenance is essential for stability.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will plan active maintenance.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'When should a periodontal tooth be extracted?' Mina replies:
options: When the prognosis is very guarded and the tooth cannot be maintained
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Extraction is justified when the prognosis is very guarded.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will evaluate the prognosis before extracting.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the benefits of periodontal treatment on general health?' Mina replies:
options: Improved glycemic control, reduced cardiovascular risks
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Periodontal treatment has systemic benefits.' 🦅 Sami: 'I will inform my patients.'
